description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Changes to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards - (SLFRS & LKAS) w.e.f. 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette content involves the adoption and publication of changes to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (SLFRS & LKAS) by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes regulatory framework updates and compliance requirements, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel or other specialized categories.
